name: @office/domain-field
description: Office work/field domain module (OFF-009): the project-scoped FieldEvent, DailyLog, Issue, and Inspection aggregates with offline-style idempotent capture (client idempotency key + client-observed timestamp, exactly-once replay through the domain-kernel IdempotencyRegistry), append-only daily-log entries and issue comments, one-way lifecycles, deny-by-default authorization through @office/authz, audit events through the EventSink port (mirroring the identity modules), a project read model rebuilt from the emitted events, and a thin ledger-backed EventSink adapter over @office/events. Pure domain: no SQL, no migrations, no repository layer — deterministic, in-memory-testable, injected clock/id suppliers. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, @office/persistence (the EventSink port's executor type), and @office/events (the ledger-backed sink adapter).
